description: Put a screenshot of an app or website on a device mockup and get a PNG. The screenshot fills the screen edge to edge (cropped to the screen's shape if its proportions differ). Give the screenshot as screenshot_url (a public https link) or screenshot_base64 (PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 10 MB).

background.description: "transparent" for a cut-out PNG, or a colour like "#ffffff". Leave it out for a soft studio grey.

clean.description: true for a picture without the watermark grid. Needs a signed-in Drisp Pro account; a Pro account gets clean pictures anyway.

frame.description: Frame colour: 0 the device's own (default), 1 the other of black / silver, 2 champagne gold, 3 midnight blue.

screenshot_base64.description: The screenshot itself, base64 (a data: URL is fine).

screenshot_url.description: A public https link to the screenshot (PNG, JPEG or WebP).

size.description: The square PNG's side in pixels (default 1024). 1536 and 2048 need a signed-in Drisp Pro account.

name: device_mockup
title: Screenshot on a device
